input.command:
COMPANY_ID="9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5"
timeout 40 npx wrangler dev --no-bundle --local 2>&1 &
WRANGLER_PID=$!
sleep 8
echo "=== request 1: companies ==="
curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/companies | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([c['name'] for c in d])" 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== request 2: company by ID ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('name'), d.get('status'))" 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== request 3: companies again (tests cross-request I/O) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/companies | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK:', len(d), 'companies')" 2>/dev/null
kill $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
input.description: Test multiple sequential requests to verify per-request DB fix
